decisions.reason: As a flagship, homepage-promoted product tied to the firm's stated direction, the firm is likely to justify and continue this visible commitment rather than withdraw it after only a few years.

This LED luminaire line is close to the core business, likely shares components and channels with established ranges, and a premium German lighting firm in a growing market would tend to persist with such an invested product family.

Although the home automation server box is somewhat more vulnerable because technology moves quickly, it supports the firm's control-and-comfort positioning, so management influenced by escalation of commitment would still be more likely to retain it than drop it.
A luminaire family with its own page represents a meaningful product-line commitment within the firm's core offer, making continued support more likely than exit absent clear evidence of failure.
